detail: LATENT ownership overlap recorded, not yet fixed (ADR-0016, pairs 6-8 of 9). This item owns a named interface doc under .program/interfaces/ that also falls inside ROOT.7.1's '.program/interfaces/**' steward glob. Nothing collides today (this item is proposed, and it is in a later phase than the steward's activation), so it is not a live violation. Resolve at decomposition using the ADR-0016 pattern: the founding item owns its doc until it closes, then the doc transfers to ROOT.7.1 via file_ownership_deferred. ADR-0007 #10 anticipated this ('interface docs get named-file protection via ROOT.1.2/7.1 globs') but the protection is convention, not construction.
